It’s obvious what’s happening. The chaos and confusion some are trying to sow around the September 21 rally against corruption is no accident—it’s Plan B of the Duterte-DDS-Senators, a desperate attempt to force a change of government. Plan A failed spectacularly when SMR refused to play their games, blocking a House coup orchestrated by former President Gloria Arroyo.

Now, emboldened by violent anti-government protests in Nepal and Indonesia—movements aimed at authoritarian regimes, including one allied with the CCP—Sara Duterte and her minions are trying to replicate the same chaos here in the Philippines. Their goal? To create instability that could allow Sara to seize power if Marcos is removed through a violent coup.

Do not be fooled. Only fools or paid propagandists would give her the time of day. The Duterte family is fast becoming the most destructive dynasty in Philippine politics, willing to destabilize the nation for personal gain.

Rally participants: you are being played. You are not fighting corruption—you are being used as pawns in a dangerous scheme to return the Dutertes to power. Stay vigilant. Keep the mission clear: fight corruption, and nothing else, and lend your voice against corruption that has become the Duterte brand.
